title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.1 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — One-Button Pro Drag Edit (Advanced Mechanics 0-Delay Engine) & Fluid Auto-Reset
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.0.1 NOVA TITAN: (1) 🎯 One-Button Pro Drag Edit Overhaul (Advanced Mechanics Engine): Hold your in-game Fortnite Edit Key (e.g. E or F) to open the edit grid and drag-select tiles with zero manual clicks; releasing your Edit Key confirms instantaneously in 0.00ms. Eliminates dual-key confusion by synchronizing Primary Edit Key with the hook trigger. (2) ⚡ 0-Delay Synchronous Hook Dispatch: Stripped Task.Run thread-pool latency on keypress so tile selection engages in < 0.3ms — zero dropped or skipped tiles on lightning flicks. (3) 🔄 Fluid Auto-Reset on Right Click: Tapping Right-Click while holding Edit resets the wall & re-primes select instantly so you can reset and re-edit in one fluid sweep. (4) ⚡ Instant 0.00ms Release & Confirm: Eliminates artificial release delays and guarantees instant confirmation for both Confirm-on-Release ON and OFF players.
